programme.title: Blue World 3 | S03E09
programme.desc: Uhonorowana nagrodą Emmy seria przyrodnicza ukazująca podwodny świat. Gospodarz programu, Jonathan Bird to amerykański filmowiec i fotograf specjalizujący się w zdjęciach podwodnych. Mężczyzna nurkuje, by w zabawny i pouczający sposób zaprezentować cuda znajdujące się w podwodnej krainie. W tym sezonie Bird udaje się m.in. na wyspę na Bahamach, by zbadać podwodne jaskinie, które zaczynają się w niebieskich dziurach. W Georgii odwiedza największe akwarium na świecie. Prowadzący pokaże również widzom Wielką Rafę Koralową oraz sprawdzi, jakie sposoby mają zwierzęta w oceanie, by ochronić się przed drapieżnikami i znaleźć partnera… USA. 2011. serial przyrodniczy

programme.title: Blue World 4 | S04E01

W kolejnej serii Bird odwiedzi m.in. akwen na Malediwach, w Meksyku spotka się z żarłaczami tępogłowymi, a na wyspie Bonaire weźmie udział w kursie freedivingu. Prowadzący dołączy również do grupy nurków-ochotników w ramach pewnego międzynarodowego wydarzenia i zobaczy, w jaki sposób biolodzy ratują populację jesiotrów w Rzece Świętego Wawrzyńca… USA. 2014. serial przyrodniczy

programme.title: David Attenborough: songs of life
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough selects seven of the most extraordinary recordings from the natural world and explores what these sounds mean to specific animal species. Each song - from that of a lemur, through the song of a humpback whale or a lyrebird from the order of passerine birds - was recorded during the lifetime of a famous naturalist who recorded and analyzed these songs for decades. The oldest recording was made when Sir David was five years old, the latest just a few years before the documentary was created. Each has an amazing story behind it and shows how much we still don't know about the natural world. When Sir David Attenborough was born, the science of song was transformed under Charles Darwin's theory of sexual selection, which labeled singing dangerous because it revealed the singer's location to predators. The same song also gives males a great chance to be noticed by the female and thus to pass on their genes to the next generation of birds. So the males sing, and the females listen and choose the best singers because, according to them, they will be the best fathers. New scientific trends in bird song are challenging these long-held ideas. Scientists invited to the program show that in fact, in most species of songbirds, females create their own songs - and only now do they have a chance to be truly heard. However, there is a concern whether we will be able to learn all the songs of these extraordinary birds - the human loss is loud, and the planet Earth is falling silently, as the host of the program also warns. The production is a continuation of the documentary film nominated for the Grierson Award. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs: The Rescuers (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep1 «Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs»…In this episode, dogs are coming to our rescue in a number of surprising ways. A Great Dane shows us how he has transformed the life of a 13-year-old Massachusetts girl with a life-limiting condition. A Search and Rescue Border Collie-cross – was once on death row in an animal shelter but now he's an integral member of the California Task Force searching for survivors when earthquakes, hurricanes or deadly mudslides strike. Ruger the anti-poaching dog is on duty in Zambia detecting illegal ivory and smuggled wildlife. And, finally, A Newfoundland helps teach his German Shepherd apprentice she needs to become a water rescue dog in Italy's Lake Garda | It is often said that dogs are man's best friend but this documentary shows that they can also make excellent colleagues too. This series looks at the ways that the natural attributes of canines are being used in the world of work in all different sectors and how dogs are used to enhance and sometimes save the lives of humans. Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs travels across different continents to meet the four-legged friends who are performing key roles in crucial work. We see how dogs are integral to the work of the police, firefighters, scientists and more. Narrated by Victoria Stilwell | Director: Blake McGrow, Sean McDonnell

programme.title: The Living Beach: Hawaii (S1E4). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2016. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep4 «The Living Beach»…Throughout the Hawaiian Islands, natural forces of creation and destruction can be observed in real-time as they work to shape the living beach. These beaches are forged inside active volcanoes: every bit of land exists here because of these red-hot furnaces | When we think of a beach, we often think of a carefree place where we can relax and do nothing. Yet for the natural world, the opposite is true – this documentary series shows us how nature is constantly at work on the world's beaches. Travelling to coastlines across the globe including Australia, Mexico and Florida, we are told how the shores have been created over time, we also learn about the diverse ecosystems and the species that call the beach home. We are shown the human impact on the beaches and the efforts being made to protect them. Narrated by Tish Iceton | Director: Josh MacDonald, Matt Trecartin | Cast: Tish Iceton

S1, Ep4 «The Living Beach»…Throughout the Hawaiian Islands, natural forces of creation and destruction can be observed in real-time as they work to shape the living beach. These beaches are forged inside active volcanoes: every bit of land exists here because of these red-hot furnaces | When we think of a beach, we often think of a carefree place where we can relax and do nothing. Yet for the natural world, the opposite is true – this documentary series shows us how nature is constantly at work on the world's beaches. Travelling to coastlines across the globe including Australia, Mexico and Florida, we are told how the shores have been created over time, we also learn about the diverse ecosystems and the species that call the beach home. We are shown the human impact on the beaches and the efforts being made to protect them. Narrated by Tish Iceton | Director: Josh MacDonald, Matt Trecartin | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep1 «Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs»…In this episode, dogs are coming to our rescue in a number of surprising ways. A Great Dane shows us how he has transformed the life of a 13-year-old Massachusetts girl with a life-limiting condition. A Search and Rescue Border Collie-cross – was once on death row in an animal shelter but now he's an integral member of the California Task Force searching for survivors when earthquakes, hurricanes or deadly mudslides strike. Ruger the anti-poaching dog is on duty in Zambia detecting illegal ivory and smuggled wildlife. And, finally, A Newfoundland helps teach his German Shepherd apprentice she needs to become a water rescue dog in Italy's Lake Garda | It is often said that dogs are man's best friend but this documentary shows that they can also make excellent colleagues too. This series looks at the ways that the natural attributes of canines are being used in the world of work in all different sectors and how dogs are used to enhance and sometimes save the lives of humans. Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs travels across different continents to meet the four-legged friends who are performing key roles in crucial work. We see how dogs are integral to the work of the police, firefighters, scientists and more. Narrated by Victoria Stilwell | Director: Blake McGrow, Sean McDonnell

programme.desc: Medusas with ten-meter-long trains, “bloodless” ice fish, sea cucumbers on legs: alien creatures cavort in the deep sea off Antarctica and in the Mariana Trench. How do animals withstand the enormous water pressure at great depths? \n\nAt 8,178 meters below the surface, a Marianas disc swam in front of the film crew's lens - a world record for a vertebrate! programme.desc: Năm 2017, Leigh và Richard mua một nhà máy bột mì Cornish bỏ hoang để khôi phục và biến thành nhà của họ. Đến năm 2021, phòng ốc và cảnh quan vẫn chưa hoàn thiện. Kevin McCloud quay lại để xem mọi việc diễn ra như thế nào.

programme.title: THỢ BÁNH THIẾU NIÊN - JUNIOR BAKE OFF
programme.desc: Các thợ làm bánh cấp dưới bước vào lều Bake Off để tham gia thử thách làm bánh thú vị trong Ngày làm bánh.

programme.title: JAMIE: FAST AND SIMPLE
programme.desc: Jamie làm món gà nướng khay Gochujang lấy cảm hứng từ Hàn Quốc, chỉ cho chúng ta tám cách sử dụng phi lê cá hồi, tạo ra món bánh mì nướng quesadilla ngoạn mục và trên hết là món bánh tart banoffee không cần nấu nướng.

programme.title: NIGELLISSIMA

programme.title: SÔ-CÔ-LA CỦA RACHEL KHOO - RACHEL KHOO'S CHOCOLAT
programme.desc: Rachel khám phá tính linh hoạt của sô cô la. Cô ấy trộn nó với món mặn trong một chiếc bút polpette, và ở Stockholm, cô ấy học cách kết hợp đồ uống với sô cô la.

programme.title: THE FIRST CLASS TRAVEL SHOW

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3

Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: CUỘC CHIẾN TÀN KHỐC - CRUEL WAR

Chồng cũ của Yan Xin quyết định đồng hành cùng cô trên hành trình đầy nguy hiểm này. Khi xung đột nảy sinh, họ chạm trán với băng đảng ma túy địa phương và một trận chiến sinh tử sắp bắt đầu.

Tuy nhiên, sự tận tâm của cô dành cho Dao Qing đã khiến anh tái sinh và trải qua nỗi đau của cái chết.
